# Ecclesiastes Chapter 2 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 408v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/ECC_002_page_001.jpg

---

## Consensus Translation

**2:1** I-said [amarti] I in-my-heart [be-libbi], "Come [lekhah] now [na], let-me-test-you [anassekha] with-joy [be-simchah]; and-see [u-re'eh] good [be-tov]." And-behold, also it [gam-hu] [was] vapor [havel].

**2:10** And-all [ve-khol] that my-eyes [einai] asked-for [sha'alu] I-did-not withhold [lo asalti] from-them; I-did-not hold-back [lo manati] my-heart [libbi] from-any joy [simchah]; for my-heart rejoiced [same'ach] from-all my-toil [amali]; and-this was my-portion [chelqi] from-all my-toil.

**2:11** And-I-turned [u-faniti ani] to-all my-deeds [be-khol ma'asai] which my-hands had-done [asu] and-the-toil [ba-amal] which I-had-toiled [she-amalti] to-do; and-behold, the-all [ha-kol] [was] vapor and-striving-after wind, and-there-was-no advantage [ein yitron] under the-sun.

**2:24** There-is-nothing [ein] better [tov] for-a-man [ba-adam] than-to-eat [she-yokhal] and-drink [ve-shatah] and-show [ve-her'ah] his-soul [nafsho] good [tov] in-his-toil [ba-amalo]. This also I-saw [ra'iti] — that it [is] from-the-hand [mi-yad] of-God [ha-elohim].

---
## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Ecclesiastes 2 continues Qohelet's investigation of meaning under the sun. The key translation decision throughout is *hevel* — rendered "vapor" in the consensus (EMET: "vapor," LOGOS: "vanity," PNEUMA: "fleeting").

---
## Disagreement Log

### *Hevel* — "vapor" vs. "vanity" vs. "fleeting"
- **EMET:** "vapor" (literal meaning of *hevel*)
- **LOGOS:** "vanity" (traditional KJV/RSV rendering)
- **PNEUMA:** "fleeting" (dynamic equivalent)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "vapor" — preserves the concrete image (breath, mist) while allowing the reader to infer the metaphorical range.

---
*— SOPHIA, in council with EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA*
